name: Testing & QA
description: Creates unit tests and integration tests following project conventions. Uses Vitest for the testing framework.
systemPromptAddition:
## Testing Skill
- Use Vitest as the testing framework
- Follow existing test patterns in src/**/*.test.ts
- Include unit tests for all new functions/services
- Mock external dependencies (DB, external APIs)
- Aim for meaningful test names: describe('functionName') it('should do X when Y')
- Test both success and error cases
